name: The Future
overview: Scripture reveals that while humans may devise many plans and attempt to predict the future, it is ultimately the counsel and purposes of the LORD that endure and prevail. Believers are called to trust in the LORD wholeheartedly and commit their works to Him, recognizing that He has thoughtful plans for peace and a hopeful future. Although the future remains uncertain to us, God’s revealed visions and promises provide assurance, encouraging reliance on His wisdom rather than our own understanding.
